event_detail: Steak on the plate: the gripper descends with open fingers around the steak (43.2 s), then closes and swings toward the cutting board (44.8 s), but the steak stays on the plate. The gripper is empty.
evidence: The knife lies on the cutting board in all frames (stage 1 done). Wrist view at 43.2 s: the steak sits between the open fingers on the plate. At 44.8 s the fingers are together with nothing between them, the cutting board and knife are ahead, and the plate with the steak still on it is left behind at the image edge. The right shoulder view at 44.8 s also shows the steak still on the plate while the arm moves away.
